title: Chapter 1468
text:
This batch of former direct descendants who joined the Supers Holy Land was only a small number of people. Most of the direct descendants still chose to stay in the three Universal Civilizations, but even so, the difference between the high-level combatants of the two sides was even greater.

However, Han Xiao was no longer afraid of openly poaching the three Universal Civilizations. Ever since he subdued the World Tree and ended the war, many problems had been solved. For example, the three Universal Civilizations had never given up on the right to spread the Ultimate Knowledge.

"The Supers Holy Land has become the temple of individual strength. This is the trend. The three Universal Civilizations know that they can't stop it, so they still compromised with me …"

Han Xiaoxin's eyes swept across everyone and suddenly locked onto Carrott, Evans, and the other new Beyond Grade As.

There was no need to emphasize Carrott and Evans' potential. Naturally, their future was limitless. However, because the World Tree War broke out many years earlier than in his previous life, they did not have enough time to grow. Even with his nurturing, this missing time was still not easy to make up for, and they were far from reaching the theoretical peak of their abilities.

Therefore, in this war, the two of them did not perform too well, but it was undeniable that they were still worth nurturing in the future.

From Han Xiao's point of view, since the Supers Holy Land had shouted the slogan of 'the holy land of the Supers', it had to show the characteristics of connecting the past and the future. It could not produce a gap in the generation of experts. Although the current peak Beyond Grade As had a long lifespan and enjoyed a reputation, it was impossible to not have a new generation of experts in the future. They had to let the galactic society see the 'individual strength nurturing ability' of the Supers Holy Land that surpassed any organization.

Although there might not be any opportunities to make a move in the future, they still needed the new generation of experts to hold down the fort for the Supers Holy Land. Han Xiao had already regarded Carrott and Evans as the future pillars of the Supers Holy Land.

The work of remodeling the territory was completed. Secret Master and the other mages summoned the teleportation gate and sent everyone back to the main planet of the Supers Holy Land.

The main planet of the Supers Holy Land was called the 'Star of Gods', and it was located at the back of the Flickering World. There were statues of all the Beyond Grade As of the Civilization Elder Association. The lineup was luxurious, and among them, Black Star's statue was the tallest and most eye-catching. It was the landmark of the entire planet.

Countless spaceships gathered on this planet from all directions, leaving behind streams of light that were like resplendent galaxies hanging upside down. Were these Supers who chose to join the Supers Holy Land?

They had come to pay their respects to the statues of the various Beyond Grade As.

This area was originally a defensive line built by the Galactic Alliance Army?

But after the war, all the stationed troops were withdrawn?

This area had a new owner.

Every Beyond Grade A has a residence here?

After everyone returned, they scattered in twos and threes?

They had gone to do their own things. Now was the time to move their respective forces to the territory of the Supers Holy Land.

Most Beyond Grade As were extremely busy.

Han Xiao returned to the office?

Aurora, Hella, Fu Ding, and the rest of the Black Star Corps came over and had a small meeting.

"The framework of the Supers Holy Land has been built. All that's left is to fill it in. There are some personnel changes that need to be explained to everyone."

Say?

Han Xiao scanned everyone.

His gaze fell on Nero as he continued.

"As the supreme leader of the Supers Holy Land, it's not suitable for me to continue leading the Black Star Corps. Nero, the army will be temporarily handed over to you."

Hearing that?

Everyone turned to look at the dumbfounded Nero with different expressions.

"Huh?

That's not appropriate, right? I'm not mentally prepared. "Nero was shocked.

He stammered, "Y-You started from scratch and only built the foundation today?

You're handing it to me just like that?

I'm afraid I can't bear the responsibility … "

Han Xiao raised his brows.

He scolded, "What the hell are you thinking? I'm only letting you be the acting Legion Commander. On the surface, I'm just a figurehead. Nominally, I won't interfere with the daily affairs of the Legion, but you still have to report to me.

Now that he had become the supreme leader of the Supers Holy Land, he needed to avoid suspicion from the outside world. If he continued to lead the Black Star Corps, it would be easy for others to have thoughts about it, and it would also be easy for the army to be inflated. Although Han Xiao was not afraid, he would avoid it if he could. It just so happened that he wanted to relieve some of the burden and relax.

After all, with his Transcendent Grade and the power of the World Tree, he no longer needed an external force to support his position. It was a good opportunity to let go of his authority and reduce the burden.

"Then I'm relieved." Nero heaved a sigh of relief.

It was not his fault for being afraid. There were too many Beyond Grade As in the army. Although he was Black Star's godson, he still could not hold the fort.

Furthermore, the brand 'Black Star Corps' was already famous throughout the universe. It stood too high, and Nero was afraid that he would lose his reputation. However, if it was just a part-time job, it would be much better.

Han Xiao turned to look at Aurora and said, "It's the same for you. Now that you're the second-in-command of the Supers Holy Land, don't continue to be the Deputy Army Commander of the Black Star Corps. Let's do the handover later."

Aurora was unwilling. "What happened to the promise that as long as I'm willing to stay, I can always stay in the army?"

Han Xiao shook his head and laughed. "Your current identity is not suitable. You have to take on the burden alone. Even if you're not in the army, our relationship will not change. As the saying goes, people walk towards the top. The Black Star Corps is just a stage in your life. It's already over."

"Humph, big liar."

Aurora turned her head to the side.

Han Xiao was helpless. He turned to look at Hella and asked, "What about you? Have you considered what I told you? Do you want to take on the position of Minister of the Supers Department?"

"Sure."

Hella nodded lightly.

"Alright, then you and Aurora can hand over your position in the army together."

Han Xiao nodded.

The Supers Holy Land was divided into five important departments based on the five Super systems. They were led by the corresponding Beyond Grade As and had great authority.

Hella's performance in this war was obvious to all. Coupled with the characteristics of the Underworld, no one had any objections to her being in charge of the Supers Department.

Originally, Han Xiao wanted Manison to be in charge of the Mechanic Department, but old Manison refused. He had no choice but to settle for the second best and let Kant take charge of the Mechanic Department. The Mage Department was managed by Milizaus, and his deputy was Secret Master. The Pugilist Department Head was Sierron, and Han Xiao planned to replace him with Carrott in the future. The best candidate for the Psychic Department was originally Kasuyi, but he had to go on a long trip, so he replaced him with a peak Psychic Beyond Grade A who had been following the association for a long time. Fu Ding was the deputy.

After a series of personnel changes, the upper echelons of the Supers Holy Land were distributed to the various meritorious officials.

Many of them were 'former members of the Black Star Corps'. Han Xiao asked them to hand over all their positions and did not force them to use the army camp to bind these people.

Although these people did not mind following him, they still had to give him face. As the upper echelons of the Supers Holy Land, it was not good to keep the title of Deputy Army Commander. It would also make it seem that the Black Star Corps controlled the decision-making power of the civilization and was too domineering … Although he had the qualifications to be a dictator now, there was no need to show it.

On the surface, a group of Beyond Grade As had left, making it seem like the upper echelons of the Black Star Corps had lost their combat power, but in reality, it did not make much of a difference to Han Xiao. In the past, he wanted to gather a large number of experts to strengthen the Black Star Corps, but now, he had to subtract them. His status had changed. These Beyond Grade As were not in the army, it did not mean that they did not listen to him.

At this moment, Hella crossed her arms and said straightforwardly, "You have to teach me how to enter the Transcendent Grade."

"I can't teach you now. Let's talk about it when you reach the bottleneck."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

He arranged the positions of the many Beyond Grade As in the army one after another. After dealing with the last person, he thought for a while and looked at Aurora.

"By the way, release Sorokin. I have something to talk to him about."

Aurora curled her lips, but she still did as she was told. Balls of gentle golden energy condensed into a physical body and gradually turned into Sorokin's appearance.

Sorokin opened his eyes and looked around. Finally, his gaze landed on Han Xiao. He asked in confusion, "Hmm? Isn't the war over? Why are you calling me out? "

Han Xiao rubbed his knuckles and said, "I have a good thing for you here. As long as you're willing to make a deal with me and not cause trouble, I'll allow you to not return to the Underworld and continue to act outside."

Hearing this, Sorokin had a suspicious look on his face.

"When did you become so good to me? Tell me, what do you want me to do? "

"The Beyond Grade A Association has established a civilization and regime called the Supers Holy Land. I'll tell you the details later. I hope you can become an upper echelon in the economy or business field and display your strengths. How about it? Are you interested?"

"There's such a good thing." Sorokin's eyes lit up.

"Just tell me if you're willing."

Han Xiao's tone was casual.

Of course, the Supers Holy Land did not lack economic professionals, but Sorokin was the best at making money among the Beyond Grade As after all. Han Xiao felt that it would be a waste of his talent to leave him in the Underworld. It was a pity, so he might as well get Sorokin out and let him do what he could.

Anyway, with his current status, he was no longer afraid of Sorokin causing any trouble.

"No problem, don't worry. With me around, I'll definitely make the economy of this Supers Holy Land prosper, grow bigger, and create more glory!" Sorokin immediately agreed.

He had nothing to do in the Underworld all day long, so of course, he would not reject such a rare opportunity to 'relax'.

As for the grudge with Black Star back then, Sorokin had already accepted his fate over the years. He was a smart person and would not keep brooding over it.

Han Xiao nodded in satisfaction. Just as he was about to say something, his communicator suddenly rang.

Beep beep beep …

He took a look and saw that it was a call from the dynasty's ruler, Marbruce.

Han Xiao waved his hand and gestured for everyone to leave. After everyone left, he picked up the call.

"What's the matter?"

"Black Star, we plan to hold a grand ceremony on January 1st, Year 800 of the Galaxy Calendar to celebrate this victory, pay tribute to the lives sacrificed in the war, and award the meritorious officials. Your Supers Holy Land should participate in it too, especially you. The entire galactic society regards you as a hero. Don't be absent."

"I'll be there."

Han Xiao nodded.

This war was indeed worthy of the three Universal Civilizations holding a grand ceremony, and the date chosen was also very meaningful. The first day of the new century … This date was probably specially chosen to make it easier for the students to recite.

After casually chatting for a while, Han Xiao told Marbruce about the choice of Hilbert and the others. Marbruce's reaction was very calm, as though he had expected it. It was a pity that Han Xiao could not see how exasperated the other party was.

After hanging up, Han Xiao calculated the date.

"There's still half a year left until the ceremony. This time is enough for the Supers Holy Land to gain a foothold. After the ceremony, there will be a lot of free time. I'll enter the Sanctum again and revive those old unlucky fellows who died in battle … At the same time, I'll figure out all the information on the Sanctum's message board."

Because the World Tree had solved the problem of the Sanctum's key, Han Xiao naturally thought of a plan, which was to use this point to continuously enter and exit the Sanctum and unlock all the information on the message board.

In theory, this operation was completely feasible.

However, this would take a lot of time. Han Xiao decided to wait until the new situation stabilized before implementing it.

"Speaking of which, I wonder what the players have been doing recently …"

Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at the players' forums. Most of the topics discussed were related to the victory of the war and the Supers Holy Land.

Now that the war was over, the players were free. Although Han Xiao had put up the 'World Tree War' Dungeon Crystal series, most of them were still in a state of idleness. They had just completed a World Main Storyline Mission, and many people could not bring themselves to do the side quests for the time being.

In addition, the fifth Pro League was already in the preparation stage, which attracted the attention of the players. Therefore, Han Xiao did not have to worry about the players having nothing better to do.

"The universe is peaceful, society is stable, everything is getting better … Tsk tsk, it's been a long time since I've been so relaxed."

Han Xiao exhaled and felt refreshed. An indescribable sense of satisfaction appeared.

…

On the other side of Star of Gods, in Manison's mansion.

Manison casually played with the cards and looked at Kasuyi, who was thinking hard about his cards. He casually said, "You've already decided to go on a long journey and found a new goal in life. I haven't congratulated you yet."

"I've lived for a long time, so I have to find something to do. There are basically no secrets in the explored universe to me. Searching for the unknown is fun." Kasuyi casually played a card and smiled. "However, speaking of which, I didn't expect you to reject Black Star's invitation and not take charge of the Machinery Department of the Supers Holy Land. You took the initiative to give up this position of real power."

"Aren't you the same?" Manison did not comment.

"I don't want to take up a position because I'm going on a long journey, but you're staying here. Why don't you want this power? This isn't like you." Kasuyi raised his eyebrows.

"I have other arrangements." Manison glanced at the card game and took out a card to play. However, after thinking about it, he stuffed the card back and changed his hand to play. He did not stop talking and said, "I plan to go into seclusion and research for a few decades. I don't want to be distracted elsewhere … Besides, with Black Star around, I'll never be able to surpass him in the eyes of a Mechanic."

"Indeed." Kasuyi sighed. "It's the misfortune of all Mechanics to be in the same era as him."

Manison looked up at him and knocked on the table. "You're not a Mechanic, so why are you so emotional?"

"To be honest, if I were you, I would have directly acknowledged Black Star as my teacher. It's not embarrassing to learn knowledge." Kasuyi shrugged.

"You talk too much. Hurry up and play your cards."

Manison snorted coldly.

Although his relationship with Han Xiao had eased up a lot and he was willing to listen to the other party's orders to a certain extent, for him to lower his head again? Absolutely impossible!

…

The establishment of the Supers Holy Land established the new situation after the war. After the initial observation, a large number of Supers from different civilizations poured into the territory of the Supers Holy Land from the various Star Fields and obtained official citizenship after being approved.

The efficiency of a Beyond Grade A organization was famous for being high. With the rapid implementation of various aspects, the Supers Holy Land had only been established for a few months before it began to operate efficiently. On the other hand, the entire galactic society had yet to recover and still needed a lot of time to adapt to the new situation.

The Supercluster Alliance also used the birth of the Supers Holy Land to get rid of the suppression it had always been under. It finally enjoyed the treatment of a normal advanced civilization and obtained a certain degree of freedom to develop.

After the war, the situation gradually stabilized. The entire galactic society was working hard to adapt to the changes after the war. In the blink of an eye, it was the end of Year 799 of the Galaxy Calendar. The celebration ceremony held by the three Universal Civilizations was held as scheduled.
